stories.title: Une enquête indépendante est demandée sur le département de Maudet

en.title: Independent investigation requested into Maudet department
en.summary: Geneva's Grand Council is calling for an independent investigation into controversial recruitment practices within Pierre Maudet's Department of Health and Mobility, while the official disputes the matter as politically motivated.

stories.title: Nations League: Deutschland-Schreck Griechenland mit Remis gegen Niederlande – Portugal siegt ohne Ronaldo

en.title: Nations League: Greece draws with Netherlands as Germany's challenger; Portugal wins without Ronaldo
en.summary: Greece remained undefeated in its Nations League group with a draw against the Netherlands, while Portugal secured victory without Ronaldo and Austria achieved a draw.

stories.title: Deutsche Fussballer bezwingen Serbien in der Nations League: Klopp feiert seine Siegpremiere

en.title: German footballers defeat Serbia in Nations League: Klopp celebrates his winning debut
en.summary: Germany's young national team defeated Serbia under new coach Klopp's first victory, marking a milestone and signaling promise for the team's football future.

stories.title: Liga A der Nations League – Dank Bischof und Wirtz: Im 3. Spiel unter Klopp siegt die DFB-Elf

en.title: Nations League A – Germany wins third match under Klopp thanks to Bischof and Wirtz, defeating Serbia
en.summary: Germany defeated Serbia 2:0 in the Nations League under Klopp in his third match, while Portugal won without Cristiano Ronaldo.

stories.title: Le Grand Conseil genevois veut une enquête indépendante sur le Département de la santé de Pierre Maudet

en.title: Geneva's Grand Council wants independent investigation into Pierre Maudet's Health Department
en.summary: Geneva lawmakers overwhelmingly approved a motion calling for an independent inquiry into alleged hiring favoritism and workplace issues within the cantonal health office, following media reports of controversial recruitment practices.

stories.title: Vorfall auf Flydubai-Flug – Netanjahu und Modi würdigen angegriffenen Piloten als Helden

en.title: Incident on Flydubai flight – Netanyahu and Modi praise attacked pilot as hero
en.summary: Following an incident on a flight to Tel Aviv, Israel's prime minister and India's premier commended the pilot for their actions.

stories.title: Mediapart révèle avoir pu authentifier les messages antisémites de Jordan Bardella, qui continue de nier

en.title: Mediapart claims to have authenticated antisemitic messages attributed to Jordan Bardella, who continues to deny
en.summary: The investigative outlet Mediapart published evidence authenticating antisemitic messages from 2013 attributed to National Rally leader Jordan Bardella, who denies authorship and has filed a complaint against the publication.

stories.title: Après l’imposition individuelle, un comité féminin repart en campagne pour les couples mariés

en.title: After individual taxation, a women's committee launches campaign for married couples' taxation
en.summary: A multi-party women's committee launched a campaign Thursday for a ballot initiative on joint taxation of married couples, scheduled for a November vote following March's individual taxation approval.

stories.title: Angriff auf Flydubai-Flug: Benjamin Netanyahu hat seinen Helden

en.title: Attack on Flydubai flight: Benjamin Netanyahu has his hero
en.summary: A man removed an alleged attacker from an aircraft cockpit, preventing a threat to approximately 180 passengers. The incident has become a focus for political commentary regarding the Prime Minister.

stories.title: Mediapart affirme avoir pu authentifier les messages antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella, qui continue de nier

en.title: Mediapart asserts it has authenticated antisemitic messages attributed to Jordan Bardella, who continues to deny
en.summary: Mediapart published screenshots of antisemitic messages from 2013 allegedly sent by National Rally president Jordan Bardella, who denies authorship and has filed a complaint against the investigative outlet.

stories.title: JO 2038: après bientôt 80 ans sans Jeux olympiques d’hiver en Suisse, le National ouvre la voie à une candidature

en.title: 2038 Olympics: after nearly 80 years without Winter Games in Switzerland, the National Council opens the way for a bid
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council approved 200 million francs in federal funding to support a bid for the 2038 Winter Olympics, advancing the country's candidacy nearly 80 years after last hosting the games in 1948.

stories.title: Le Conseil national soutient l'organisation des Jeux olympiques d'hiver 2038 en Suisse

en.title: National Council supports organization of 2038 Winter Olympics in Switzerland
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council has expressed support for hosting the 2038 Winter Olympic Games in the country.

stories.title: Rohstoffskandal landet bei der Schweizer Justiz: US-Investor reicht Strafanzeige gegen Radiant World ein

en.title: Commodities scandal reaches Swiss justice: US investor files criminal complaint against Radiant World
en.summary: A New York financial firm has reported a loss of 49 million dollars and suspects Radiant World of fraud. Commodity giant Glencore also conducted business with the controversial company.

stories.title: Die Flugsicherheit rückt wieder in den Fokus: die wirtschaftlichen Folgen der Beinahe-Katastrophe bei Flydubai

en.title: Flight safety back in focus: economic consequences of near-catastrophe at Flydubai
en.summary: A violent incident on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv has disrupted air traffic, causing Israel to temporarily lose a key route. Airlines now face pressure to improve crew screening procedures.

stories.title: Donald Trump kündigt Milliardeninvestitionen Südkoreas an

en.title: Donald Trump announces South Korean billion-dollar investments
en.summary: The US President describes plans including a power plant, eight nuclear reactors, and a gas pipeline. South Korea has downplayed the announcement, but the pattern shows allied nations paying substantially for lower tariffs and security commitments.

stories.title: «Geht zum Teufel, wir wollen euch nicht!»: Warum sind die Amerikaner so wütend auf die KI-Rechenzentren? Eine Spurensuche in Texas

en.title: "Go to Hell, We Don't Want You!": Why Are Americans So Angry About AI Data Centers? An Investigation in Texas
en.summary: Opposition to AI data centers is growing across the United States, including in business-friendly Texas. Local resistance is prompting political action ahead of midterm elections.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Die Schweizer Jahresinflation erreicht ein Prozent +++ Mercedes-Benz reaktiviert Abfindungsprogramm in Deutschland

en.title: ECONOMIC REPORTS - Swiss annual inflation reaches one percent +++ Mercedes-Benz reactivates severance program in Germany
en.summary: Swiss annual inflation has reached one percent. Mercedes-Benz is reactivating a severance package program for its German workforce.
